description: Source code for Microchip Breathing-Blinking LED controller driver for Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, initialization, and control functions.

methods.name: calc_blink_32k_prescaler
methods.description: Calculates the prescaler value for blinking based on delay on/off in milliseconds.

methods.name: calc_blink_duty_cycle
methods.description: Calculates duty cycle scaled to [0, 255] based on delay on/off.

methods.name: xec_bbled_blink
methods.description: Enables hardware blinking of the LED with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: xec_bbled_slp_en_clr
methods.description: Clears sleep enable for the LED hardware, implementation varies by SOC series.

methods.name: xec_bbled_init
methods.description: Initializes the LED hardware, sets default state and pin configuration.
